warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). Only 3 door types + 4 window types for this whole small house — consistent with its compact 1-bedroom/1-bathroom accessible design.

Door mark 1 (2.05x2.00 sliding, living room) and window mark 1 (1.85x1.15) share the same numeral by coincidence — recorded distinctly by row position (top row = door set, second row references differ) per the printed layout, not renumbered.
NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: a packed size string (e.g. "0.20x0.40") was replaced by numeric width_mm/height_mm per schema 0.5; the printed text is kept in the matching *_printed_as field.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02(r5): the door_window_schedule[] array was folded into elements[] using the field names houses 01-05 use (element_id/element_type/opening_type/leaf_material, width_mm/height_mm). Original mark text kept in element_id_printed_as, original size string in size_printed_as.
